title: Ruby OOP Advanced
intro: Ruby's object model is deeper than most engineers realise until an interviewer starts asking. Everything is an object — BasicObject sits at the root, Object inherits from it, Module and Class are themselves objects. This page covers the OOP questions that separate candidates who have used Ruby from those who understand it: the method lookup chain and how include, extend, and prepend each modify it; open classes and safe monkey-patching; duck typing and respond_to? over instanceof checks; the difference between class methods and instance methods via self; and the Comparable mixin contract. Interviewers at companies like Shopify, GitHub, and Basecamp use these topics to assess whether a candidate can design extensible Rails code — not just scaffold it.
